pkgmetadata.longdescription: HeDE (the Helm Desktop Environment) is a lightweight Qt/Wayland desktop shell for Gentoo, built around GeST as its Control Center. It provides a session supervisor (helm-session) that runs the labwc compositor, a layer-shell panel (helm-panel) with a clock and a Start button, and a searchable freedesktop application launcher (helm-menu). The shell is QtWidgets-first and depends only on Qt 6 plus layer-shell-qt.
